# Promoted to repo memory: writeback-collisions

Cite these in .sofar/repo.md by qualified handle — `writeback-collisions M<n>` —
which is how `sofar doctor` sees that a promoted fact reached repo memory.

- **M1** (2026-08-06T09:55:40.238Z) — record-hygiene D1's git/sofar exemption applies only when EVERY segment of a compound command is git or sofar — isSelfRecordingCommand uses segments.every(). So `git push origin main | tail -3`, `git diff && echo ...`, and `git commit -F - <<'EOF'` with a prose heredoc all DO get recorded as command_run, and the tree is dirty again the instant it is clean. To settle the tree at wrap-up, run git bare and unpiped: `git add -A && git commit -m "..."` (quoted message, no heredoc, no pipe), then `git push origin main` on its own.
